summary: The inverted space-to-tab range was normalized to U+0009–U+0020, making [[:blank:]] incorrectly match control characters U+000A–U+001F. The fix uses separate singleton ranges for tab and space. The fix-added regression test exists through the ismatch! macro in tests/regression.rs, included as module regression by tests/test_default.rs (integration target default, package regex), and expects no match against those control characters.
